people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
translations.bsb: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
translations.kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
translations.asv: Him did God exalt with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
